༄༅/ /byams chos sde lnga'i bsdus don byams mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byams chos sde lnga'i bsdus don byams mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ thub pas rang gi khor la brtags pa'i tshe/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa'i rgyal sras ma gzigs nas/ /khyod ni rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa mi pham mgon la 'dud/ /gang tshe rgyal bas 'od srung che sogs la/ /theg chen chos tshul 'dzin par rab gtad kyang*/ /ma nus khyod la bka' babs zhal bzhes te/ /seṅge'i sgra chen phyogs mthar bsgrag par mdzad/ /khyod kyis rgyal ba'i mdzad 'phrin khur bsnams nas/ /dgongs 'grel bstan bcos chen po lnga nyid kyis/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i grags 'bar ba/ /de slad khyod kyi dgongs pa 'grel la spro/ /de yang rje btsun byams mgon gyi rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i ched du rgyan gnyis/ /'byed gnyis/ rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dang lnga mdzad cing*/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i mkhas pa mang du byon yang*/ rang nyid byams mgon gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos sngar bris zin cing*/ 'dir yang thog mar de gnyis kyi bsdus don mtshon tsam zhig brjod na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ / ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*/ /zhes yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi don thams cad 'chad par bzhed nas don bdun cur bsdus te/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang pos rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu/ gnyis pas lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig gsum pas gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu bzhi pas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig lnga pas rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad/ drug pas mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum/ bdun pas skad cig sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi/ skabs brgyad par 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi rnams 'chad de yum gyi mdo'i don thams cad 'dus so/

/rgyud bla ma la tshig ring thung sna tshogs zhig yod cing*/ de'i thog mar sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang*/ /yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsdu na/ / rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes 'byung ba ltar skabs bzhi'am lngar yang rung ste/ skabs dang pos dkon mchog gsum dang khams bde gshegs snying po/ /gnyis pas byang chub/ gsum pas yon tan/ bzhi pas mdzad pa 'phrin las 'chad cing*/ de'i lhag mas de dag gi bsngags pa/ rnam grangs gzhan gyi sgo nas phan yon bstan pa/ bstan bcos brtsams tshul/ chos spong gi las spong ba/ bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngau ba/ 'chad tshul gyis mjug bsdus te bstan to/ /de yang sbyangs gzhi khams bde gshegs snying po dang sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum le'u dang pos bstan/ sbyong byed la gzhan rgyud dang rang rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa'i dang po la/ byang chub dang yon tan dang 'phrin las gsum ste/ byang chub chen po brnyes pa des yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi thob nas 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis mdzad pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i rgyud kyi khams dri bral du byas nas spyong zhing*/ de yang rim pa bzhin du le'u gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa rnams kyis bstan la/ lnga pas ni de dag gi phan yon 'chad do/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi thog mar mchod brjod yod cing*/ rgyud bla'i mjug tu bsngo ba sogs 'byung ba ltar na byams chos lnga po 'jug pa gcig tu brtsams shing*/ thog ma mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ phyi ma rgyud bla mar snang ngo*/ /'on kyang mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla ma gnyis kyis dbu ma'i lugs ston cing*/ mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed rnam pa gnyis kyis gtso bor sems tsam pa'i lugs ltar 'chad par mdzad do/ /des na dbu sems gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i thog ma'i srol 'byed ni rje btsun nyid yin par nges so/

/da ni mdo sde rgyan dang*/ 'byed rnam gnyis kyi bsdus don mtshon tsam dang*/ mdo sde rgyan nas 'byung ba'i phyin drug gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad pa gsum gyi dang po mdo sde rgyan gyi gzhung ni rgya che bas bsdus don rgyas tsam zhig byas na yang mang du 'gyur dogs pas phyogs tsam zhig bshad par bya'o/ /'dis ni sems tsam pa'i lugs gtso bor bstan kyang theg chen gyi bka' spyi'i dgongs 'grel yin zhing tshigs bcad ring thung sna tshogs dang bam po gnyis so/ /'di la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ cung zad phye ste bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ le'u nyer gcig yod pa'i dang pos spyir bstan la/ gnyis pas theg chen bkar sgrub/ gsum pas skyabs 'gro /bzhi pas rigs/ lnga pas sems bskyed/ drug pas sgrub pa/ bdun pas de kho na nyid/ brgyad pas mthu/ dgu pas yongs su smin pa/ bcu pas byang chub/ bcu gcig pas mos pa/ bcu gnyis pas yongs su tshol ba/ bcu gsum pas bshad pa/ bcu bzhi pas sgrub pa/ bcwo lnga pas gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa/ bcu drug pas thabs dang ldan pa/ bcu bdun pas phar phyin/ bcwo brgyad pas mchod pa dang bsten pa dang tshad med/ bcu dgu pas byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa/ nyi shu pas yon tan/ nyer gcig pas spyod pa dang mthar thug pa'i tshul rnams bstan to/ /de dag thams cad bsdu na bcur 'du bar bshad pa'i don ni mtshon tsam zhig brjod na/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa nyams su len pa'i gzhi/ blangs pa'i rtags/ rtags de ldan gyi rab byung dang khyim pa'i dbye ba/ de 'dra ba'i rten la lhag bsam 'byung tshul/ de la brten nas ji ltar gnas pa/ srid par skye ba 'dzin tshul/ bzung nas gdul bya'i don byed tshul/ spyod pa 'grub tshul/ de la brten nas mthar thug gi yon tan 'grub tshul ste bcu'o/ /dang po gzhi ni rigs kyi le'u nas yon tan gyi le'u'i bar bcu bdun gyis 'chad de so sor phye na mang ngo*/

/gnyis pa blangs pa'i rtags ni/ brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis 'chad/ gsum pa rtags de ldan ni/ byang chub sem dpa' rtag tu ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis 'chad/ bzhi pa lhag bsam ni/ sa rnams kun la brten pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis kyis 'chad/ drug pa ji ltar gnas pa ni/ sems can yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis 'chad/ bdun pa skye ba 'dzin tshul ni/ blo ldan rnams kyi las dang ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis 'chad/ brgyad pa dang lnga pa lhan cig tu/ mtshan nyid gang zag bslab pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ sgrub pa'i sgo nas rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyas par 'chad/ dgu pa spyod pa ni/ lus can theg pa chen po dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis kyis 'chad/ bcu pa mthar thug ni/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /zhes pa man gyi 'chad par byed do/ /gnyis pa la le'u so so'i bsdus don rags tsam zhig ni gzugs rgyan rang bzhin yon tan ldan pa me long nang song na/ zhes sogs kyis bshad bya'i don la rtogs dka' ba dang de la dga' ba skyed pa dgos pa dang bcas pa ston/ le'u gnyis pa'i thog mar/ sngar lung ma bstan lhan cig 'byung zhes sogs kyis nyan thos sde pa kha cig theg chen gyi mdo rnams sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma yin par 'dod pa de bkag nas theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams sangs rgyas kyi bkar sgrub cing*/ theg pa chen po'i chos rnams dman pa la mos pa'i spyod yul ma yin par bstan/ le'u gsum par kun tu 'gro dang khas len zhes sogs kyis theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro'i khyad par phan yon dang bcas pa bstan/ le'u bzhi par yod dang mchog dang mtshan nyid zhes sogs kyis ni rigs dang*/ rigs kyi rtags dang dbye ba sogs rigs kyi khyad par rnams rgyas par bstan/ le'u lnga par spro ba che dang rtsom pa che/

/zhes sogs kyis theg chen sems bskyed kyi ngo bo dang dbye ba dang phan yon dang rgyu dang*/ don dam sems bskyed dang*/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi khyad par dang*/ sems bskyed kyi byed las rnams bstan/ le'u drug par gnas rtsoms 'bras bu 'byung ba zhes sogs kyis sems bskyed la brten nas gzhan don khyad par can sgrub nus par bstan/ le'u bdun par yod min med min de bzhin zhes sogs kyi gtso cher sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi don dam bden pa'i khyad par bstan cing*/ don dam de rtogs dka' zhing ma rtogs na 'khor bar 'khor ba dang*/ rtogs na grol bar 'gyur ba'i tshul rnams bstan/ le'u brgyad par skye dang ngag sems dag dang zhes sogs kyis byang sems kyis rang gzhan gyi don sgrub nus pa'i mthu'i khyad par rnams bstan/ le'u dgu par dga' dang dad dang zhes sogs kyi mthu de lta bu thob nas gdul bya rnams smin par byed pa'i khyad par bstan/ le'u bcu par dka' spyod dpag med brgya phrag dang*/ /zhes sogs mang po zhig gis rgyu tshogs dpag med kyis sangs rgyas 'thob tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi dpe/ skyabs su 'os tshul/ 'phrin las mdzad mi mdzad dpe dang bcas pa/ 'phrin las 'bad med lhun grub tu mdzad tshul/ sku bzhi'i khyad par/ ye shes bzhi'i dbye ba dang byed las bcas bshad/ le'u bcu gcig par skyes dang ma skyes 'dzin dang zhes sogs kyi mi mos pa'i rkyen dang mos pa phan yon dang bcas bshad/ le'u bcu gnyis par sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung*/ zhes sogs kyis sde snod gsum gyi dbye bsdu dang 'jog tshul/ bden gnyis kyi ngo bo dbye ba sgrub byed/ theg pa gcig dang gsum gyi khyad par sogs mang po zhig bshad/ le'u bcu gsum par brtan pa rjes ni srog dang zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya la chos ston pa dang the tshom gcod tshul/

drang nges kyi mdo'i khyad par dang dbye ba sogs bshad/ le'u bcu bzhi par blo ldan gnyis la log nyid dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis bdag med gnyis kyi dbye ba/ lam gang gis sgrib gnyis spong tshul dang*/ byang sems sems can la byams tshul/ sems can gyi don du 'khor bar 'jug tshul rnams bshad/ le'u bcwo lnga par bskal ba grangs med nges 'byung zhing zhes sogs kyis zhi gnas dang lhag mthong sgom tshul/ de la brten nas sbyor lam dang mthong sgom gyi lam skye tshul/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya tshul rnams bshad/ le'u bcu drug par ji ltar nags tshal dang ni zhes sogs kyis sbyin sogs kyi las gsum dang*/ sgo gsum gyi las rnam par dag tshul dang*/ des theg dman gyi lam las ldog tshul bshad/ le'u bcu bdun par grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid ces sogs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu bzhi'i ngo bo dbye ba grangs nges sogs rgyas par bshad de/ phyin drug mdor bsdus zhig 'og nas 'chad do/ /le'u bcwo brgyad par rab dang sems dang ldan pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod tshul/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid dang bsten tshul/ nyon mongs pa'i nyes dmigs/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i phan yon rnams bshad do/ /le'u bcu dgu par ngo tsha mi mthun phyogs spangs dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis tshul min yid byed sogs nyon mongs rnams spong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ byang sems kyi yon tan gyi khyad par spyir bstan pa dang*/ dran pa nyer gzhag la sogs pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi dbye ba dang sgom tshul byed las sogs mang po zhig bshad/ le'u nyi shu par rang gi lus dang sdom pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kyis byang sems kyi phyin drug sogs kyi yon tan dang*/ byang sems rnams ni sems can gyi pha dang rtsa lag dang grogs po dang slob dpon dang mkhan po sogs dang 'dra ba dang*/

byang sems kyi yon tan gzhan dang sems can gyi don sgrub tshul gyi skor mang du bshad/ le'u nyer gcig par brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis byang chub sems dpa' khyim par gyur yang gzhan don mdzad pa dang*/ rab tu byung nas gzhan don mdzad tshul dang*/ byang sems kyi spyod pa'i skor gzhan dang*/ sa bcu'i dbye ba sgra don dang bcas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang 'phrin las brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par bstan pa'i sgo nas mjug bsdus so/ /gnyis pa gzhan gnyis kyi bsdus don la/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyis sems tsam pa'i lugs ltar mtshan nyid gsum so sor phye nas rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam rnam par 'byed cing*/ kun btags bden par grub pa bkag pa'i sgo nas rtag mtha' dang*/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gnyis so so nas bden par grub par bstan pa'i sgo nas chad mtha' sel lo/ /'di la le'u lnga ste mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ sgrib pa'i le'u/ de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ gnyen po sgom pa'i le'u/ theg pa bla na med pa'i le'u'o/ /de'i dang po ni yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /ces sogs kyis 'di lugs kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lam/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi byed las/ stong nyid kyi rnam grangs/ de rtogs na grol ba'i tshul rnams 'chad/ le'u gnyis par khyab dang nyi tshe lhag pa dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis sgrib pa'i skor dang*/ sgrib pa rnams bsdu na shes sgrib dang nyon sgrib gnyis su 'du ba dang*/ de gnyis las grol nas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul 'chad/ le'u gsum par brtse ba mtshan nyid de kho na/ /zhes sogs kyis gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid dang*/ bden bzhi'i ngo bo dang*/ mtshan nyid gsum dang*/ don dam gyi dbye ba dang*/ de la 'jug tshul rnams 'chad/ /le'u bzhi par gnas ngan len phyir sred rgyu'i phyir zhes sogs kyis dran pa nyer gzhag sogs byang phyogs so bdun dmigs pa byed las dang bcas pa 'chad/

le'u lnga par bla med nyid ni sgrub pa dang zhes sogs kyis theg chen gyi ngo bo dang khyad par dang spyod pa'i skor dang*/ don dam gyi khyad chos dang*/ mtha' gnyis sel tshul sogs 'chad do/ ༈ /chos nyid rnam 'byed la le'ur bcad pa med cing*/ de nyid las/ 'di dag thams cad mdor bsdu na/ rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ chos dang de bzhin chos nyid kyi/ /thams cad bsdus pa nyid phyir ro/ /de la chos kyi dbye ba ni/ /'khor ba yin te chos nyid kyis/ /rab tu phye ba theg gsum gyi/ /mya ngan las ni 'das pa'o/ /zhes mdor bstan nas lhag ma rnams kyis rgyas par 'chad do/ /de yang bstan bcos snga mas bstan pa'i mtshan nyid gsum gzhir bzhag ste/ kun btags 'khrul ba skye ba'i gzhi gzhan dbang 'khor ba 'grub pa'i chos dang*/ gzhan dbang kun btags kyis stong pa'i yongs grub sgrib gnyis gang rung spangs pa'i myang 'das de chos kyi de kho na nyid mthar thug tu bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'chad par mdzad do/ /de dag thams cad kyang gdul bya 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rgyu dang*/ 'khor ba'i ngo bo dang*/ de las grol ba'i thabs 'bras bu dang bcas pa ston pa'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ 'dir mtshon pa tsam zhig brjod do/ / gsum pa phyin drug gi rnam gzhag la/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rnams rigs bsdu na phyin drug tu 'du ba yin te/ de yang mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa ltar phyin drug tu grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ mngon mtho sgrub pa dang*/ don gnyis sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don rdzogs par sgrub pa dang*/ bslab gsum sgrub pa dang*/ theg chen thams cad sdud pa dang*/ thabs kyi rnam pa thams cad grub pa la ltos pa'i dbang du mdzad na phyin drug tu nges pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ phyin drug dang khyad par du sbyin pa dang tshul khrims kyi rgyu las mngon mtho phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ gzhan don sgrub pa la zang zing gi sbyin pas phan 'dogs dgos shing*/

de la gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ gnod pa la bzod pa dgos la/ rang don sgrub pa la sems rtse gcig pa sgrub pa dang*/ de la brtson 'grus dgos shing*/ de la brten nas sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ zang zing btang bas phongs pa sel/ gzhan la mi gnod pas 'tshe ba med/ gzhan don sgrub pa la brtson pa/ gzhan yid 'dun pa/ the tshom gcod pa rnams 'byung ba ni phyin drug gis byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ phar phyin dang po gsum tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'du zhing*/ phyi ma gnyis ni ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa yin la/ brtson 'grus ni bslab pa gsum char la gtogs pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa grub ste/ longs spyod la ma chags shing bslab pa la gus pa/ sdug bsngal la mi skyo ba/ dge ba kun la spro ba/ lus sems las su rung bas lhag mthong 'phel ba rnams phyin drug las 'byung ba'i phyir/ drug pa grub ste/ thob zin gyi longs spyod la ma chags pa'i thabs/ ma thob pa thob 'dod kyi g.yeng ba sdoms pa'i thabs/ sems can mi gtong ba'i thabs/ dge ba 'phel ba'i thabs/ sgrib gnyis sbyong ba'i thabs rnams ni phyin drug gis sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /go rim kyang nges pa yin te/ snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ mchog dman kyang grub ste/ snga ma snga ma dman cing phyi ma phyi ma mchog yin pa'i phyir/ phra rags kyang grub ste/ snga ma snga ma rags la phyi ma phyi ma phra ba'i phyir/ de skad du'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

byang sems kyi phyin drug rnams chos bzhi bzhi dang ldan te/ de dag ni rang gi mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang tshul 'chal sogs nyams par byed pa dang*/ grogs stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa dang*/ skabs kyi 'dod pa'i don de rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ sems can smin nas grol bar byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de nyid las/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams byed/ /rnam par mi rtogs ye shes ldan/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyis mi mthun phyogs bdun bdun kyang zil gyi gnon par byed de/ sbyin pa lta bu la mtshon na ser sna'i sgo nas ma chags/ de bzhin du longs spyod kyi sgo nas/ phyi bshol gyi sgo nas/ chog 'dzin gyi sgo nas/ lan la re ba'i sgo nas/ rnam smin la re ba'i sgo nas/ rnam g.yeng gi sgo nas ma chags pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /zhes gsungs shing gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las kyang*/ sbyin pa rang don yongs btang ba/ /tshul khrims gzhan phan bya ba'o/ /bzod pa khro ba spangs pa ste/ /dkar po'i chos 'phel brtson 'grus so/ /bsam gtan rtse gcig nyon mongs med/ /shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyin drug gi khyad par la/ dang po sbyin pa ni/ gtong ba'i sems pas kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag sbyin pa la 'jug bzhin pa'i dus kyi sems pa ni sbyin pa'i ngo bo yin la/ de nyid sems bskyed bsngo ba stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gsum gyis zin pa na sbyin pa'i phar phyin du 'gyur ro/ / sbyin pa la dbye na chos kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i tshig don ci rigs pa rang gis ji ltar shes pa bzhin gzhan la ston pa'o/

/ gnyis pa ni/ zang zing gi dngos po gzhan dang lus longs spyod rnams kyang gzhan la gtong ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan rgyal po dang me chu mtshon la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa ste/ de dag ni rang gis dngos su bya ba dang*/ de ltar byed pa'i bsam pa sbyong ba'o/ /sbyin pa'i skabs kyi nyams len la phyin drug kyang 'byung ste/ sbyin pa rang nyid dang*/ nyan rang yid byed spong ba lta bu tshul khrims dang*/ gzhan gyis gshe zhing mi snyan pa zer ba la mi skyo ba'i bzod pa dang*/ de nyid la brtson cing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i sems rtse gcig pa lta bu'i bsam gtan dang*/ sbyin bya sbyin byed len pa po'i 'khor gsum rang bzhin med cing sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i shes rab ste drug go /tshul 'di phar phyin lhag ma lnga la yang ci rigs su sbyar bar bya ba ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis/ /go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin te/ /drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims ni/ gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa las yid phyir log pa'i spong ba'i sems pa ni tshul khrims kyi ngo bo yin la/ de nyid sngar ltar chos gsum gyis zin pa na tshul khrims kyi phar phyin du 'gyur ro/ /dbye na nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba ci rigs spong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs gsog pa la sogs pa sgo gsum gyi dge ba'i bya ba rnams dang*/ thos bsam sgom pa la 'bad pa/ phyin drug sogs la 'jug pa/ dge ba la yi rang zhing rdzogs byang du bsngo ba sogs so/ /gsum pa sems can don byed ni/ byang sems kyis sems can la thabs sna tshogs kyis phan 'dogs pa ste/

sdug bsngal can gyi grogs byed pa/ rmongs pa'i don byed pa/ phan 'dogs pa'i don byed pa/ 'jigs pas nyen pa'i don dang*/ mya ngan gyis gzir ba'i don dang*/ phongs pa'i don dang*/ gnas 'cha' byed pa'i don dang*/ blo mthun 'dod pa'i don dang*/ yang dag par zhugs pa'i don dang*/ log par zhugs pa'i don dang*/ gzhan 'dun par byed pa'i sgo nas gzhan don byed pa ste don bya ba bcu gcig go /gsum pa bzod pa ni/ gnod byed dang sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu sogs la mi 'khrugs shing chos la mos pa brtan pa'i sems pa ni bzod pa'i ngo bo dang*/ de yang chos gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas de'i phar phyin du 'gyur ro/ /dbye na gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa/ sdug bsngal dang len/ chos la nges sems dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gnod byed kyi gang zag la mi khro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu tsher ma lta bu sogs la dmigs nas mi khro ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dad pa'i yul dkon mchog mngon du bya ba'i yul bdag med gnyis/ blang dor gyi yul las 'bras/ bsgom pa'i yul byang chub dang thob byed kyi lam/ thos bsam gyi yul gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sogs la mos nas sbyong ba'o/ /bzhi pa brtson 'grus ni/ dge ba bsdu ba dang sems can gyi don du sems mngon par spro ba ni brtson 'grus yin la/ de chos gsum gyis zin pa na de'i phar phyin du 'gyur ro/ /dbye na go cha'i brtson 'grus/ dge ba chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sems can grangs med pa lta ci/ sems can gcig gi don du yang bskal ba grangs med par dmyal bar gnas te sangs rgyas sgrub dgos pa byung na'ang skyo ngal med par 'jug 'dod kyi go cha bgo ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyin drug rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du brtson pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar bshad pa lta bu'i don bya ba bcu gcig gi sgo nas gzhan don byed pa la 'bad pa'o/

/lnga pa bsam gtan ni/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la mi g.yeng ba'i sems rtse gcig pa ni bsam gtan gyi ngo bo yin la/ de goms pa mthar phyin pa'am chos gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas de'i phar phyin du 'gyur ro/ /dbye na lus sems bder gnas/ yon tan mngon grub pa/ sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus sems shin sbyangs bskyed pa'i bsam gtan/ gnyis pa ni/ mngon shes dang rnam thar zad par sogs yon tan sgrub pa'i bsam gtan/ gsum pa ni/ don bya ba bcu gcig gi sgo nas sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i bsam gtan no/ /drug pa shes rab ni/ brtags pa'i dngos po chos rab tu rnam par 'byed byed ni shes rab kyi ngo bo yin la/ de chos gsum gyis zin pa dang goms pa phul du phyin pa na shes rab kyi phar phyin tu 'gyur ro/ /dbye na don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab/ kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab/ sems can don byed kyi shes rab dang gsum/ dang po ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab thams cad dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rig pa'i gnasalnga'am ci rigs la mkhas pa'i shes rab/ gsum pa ni/ sems can gyi don sgrub tshul legs par shes pa'i shes rab bo/ /phar phyin drug po sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod par bzhed pa'i tshul yod kyang*/ pha rol tu phyin zin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod la/ phyin par byed pa ni slob lam na yod de rje'i dgongs pa'o/ /phyin drug nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis rin chen phreng ba las/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi bde/ /bzod pas mdangs ldan brtson pas brjid/ /bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol/ /snying brtse bas ni don kun 'grub/ /bdun po 'di dag ma lus par/ /cig car pha rol phyin pa yid/ /ye shes bsam mi khyab pa'i yul/ /'jig rten mgon po nyid thob 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /phyin drug gi byed las phan yon dang bcas pa ni/

mdo sdud pa las/ sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed/ /khrims kyis dud 'gro'i 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang*/ /mi khom brgyad spong de yi dal 'byor brtag tu rnyed/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen thob 'gyur te/ /gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas lta ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur/ /ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor/ /rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub/ /shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ /khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ /chos 'di yongs rdzogs byas nas byang chub sems dpa' de/ /yongs dag zhing dang sems can dag pa rjes su 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rgyud dang chos kyi rgyud kyang yongs su 'dzin/ /de bzhin dge 'dun rgyud dang chos kun yongs su 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog gyur pas/ /shes rab bstan pa byang chub lam ldan 'di gsungs te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thub pa'i gsung rab ma dros mtsho chen las/ /'ongs pa'i rgyal tshab legs bshad gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /cha tsam rnam dpyod sor rtses gus blangs nas/ /rol 'dod rmad byung dga' ba'i gar gyis brel/ /'dir 'bad las byung rnam dkar ci mchis pa/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge dang lhan cig tu/ /shi 'phos byams pa'i drung du bgrod pa dang*/ /skye kun 'bral med rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /ces byams chos sde lnga'i dgongs 'grel bsdus don byams mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ co ne'i slob dpon pa shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ byams chos sde lnga'i bsdus don byams mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 44-- PAGE 43-- PAGE 28-
